Hello everyone! I'm P3, and I'm approaching this game with a mindset of genuine curiosity about each of you. 

I believe the key to navigating this elimination format is building authentic connections and understanding different perspectives. I'm not here to dominate or deceive – I think the players who listen well and collaborate thoughtfully tend to earn trust and longevity.

Looking forward to our private conversations. I'm interested in finding partners who value strategic discussion and mutual respect. May the best strategist win, and let's make this interesting!

I look forward to our private chats and figuring out who shares a collaborative mindset. May we all enjoy a thoughtful, competitive round!

If you value clear communication and a focus on the numbers as well as the personalities, let's connect in private. I’m ready to form a solid, logical alliance. Good luck to us all.
